description: US doctors by specialty and city from Healthline FindCare: physician name with credentials, practice address, phone, NPI number (from the profile id), photo and profile link, as listed on the city page (up to ~60). Specialty uses Healthline's slug (cardiology, dermatology, family-medicine, orthopedic-surgery, pediatrics…). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City name, e.g. Chicago, San Antonio

specialty.description: Specialty slug, e.g. cardiology, dermatology, family-medicine, internal-medicine, psychiatry

state.description: US state code, e.g. IL, TX, CA
